item.title: ‘UNDERSTAND DEMENTIA’: Rickmansworth Residents’ Association invites community to Dementia Information Day
item.description: The Rickmansworth Residents’ Association (RDRA) warmly invites all residents to attend a Dementia Information Day on Tuesday, March 5. The event will run from 10.00am to 12.30pm at the William Penn Leisure Centre, Shepherds Lane, Mill End, Rickmansworth, WD3 8JN.
